title: Client Connector flow logging on Windows

prose.label: Records.
prose.text: Where the reported flows appear in ZIA and what their fields are is not captured {{gap:flow-record-fields}}.

checks.do: Whether the Windows app profile enables Flow Logging and Install WFP Driver before expecting flow records for direct or ZPA traffic.

flow-logging.statement: Flow Logging, an app profile option on Windows, installs a WFP-based Zscaler driver that logs flows to capture traffic Client Connector excludes; it needs Install WFP Driver and is enabled by Zscaler Support.

quotes: Flow Logging: When enabled, a WFP-based Zscaler driver is installed for flow logging to capture excluded traffic.
You must enable Install WFP Driver to use this feature. Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.

flow-areas.statement: Client Connector logs and reports flows to ZIA for the areas enabled: traffic through the Private Access tunnel, direct traffic that neither Zscaler nor a VPN handles, and traffic Client Connector itself blocks (Unclassified Flow).

quotes: Zscaler Client Connector logs and reports traffic flows to Internet & SaaS from the following areas you enable:
ZPA: Traffic that goes through the Private Access Tunnel.
Direct: Traffic that goes to the internet/intranet directly (i.e., the traffic not handled by Zscaler or VPN).
Whether the Flow Logger should report the traffic blocked by Zscaler Client Connector. This type of flow is also known as Unclassified Flow.

api-field.statement: The web policy's Windows block carries `flowLoggerConfig`, which matches Flow Logging by name; the API reference gives it no description.
api-field.conditions: Name correspondence only; no source maps flowLoggerConfig to the console option or documents its value.

go-flow-fields.statement: The Go SDK's company-info model also has flow-logger fields (`enableFlowLogger`, `flowLoggingBufferLimit`, `flowLoggingTimeInterval` and per-area `flowLogger…Visibility` flags), and its web policy model has `flowLoggingSelected`; they match Flow Logging by name only.
go-flow-fields.conditions: Name correspondence only; no source documents these fields or maps them to console options.

flow-record-fields.title: Where flow-logging records appear and their fields
flow-record-fields.detail: The app profile article says flows are reported to Internet & SaaS but no captured article gives the record type or a field table, and no ZCC log type exists in the graph. flowLoggerConfig is matched to the console's Flow Logging option by name only (api-field); how flow logs relate to the local client log is still unsourced, as the legacy doc said.
